start: More, a gym with a year of members, fees and check-ins on record

Hindi or rupee letters shown as boxes in Excel

must_not: Staff giving free days for a friend referral that only the owner may give

note: Name up to 80 and interest up to 200 letters; the interest text goes into the WhatsApp message; empty filters say "Nobody to call today"
Overdue, today and later are split by the India day; the default follow-up is tomorrow
Two desks working the same enquiry; the desk leaves for a call or WhatsApp from this very screen

why_not: no setting belongs to enquiries on the panel: the words are plain English and nothing is sent by itself
note: none
Each enquiry card carries up to five buttons in a grid
Enquiries saved before source and lost reason existed must show "Not asked" and "Not known"
An enquiry added on the desk phone, and one made by a member with Bring a friend, must reach the owner laptop

title: The WhatsApp follow-up to a web-page enquiry carries the system note
what: For a person who asked on the gym web page or joined online, the ready WhatsApp message reads "you asked about <gym> (Asked on your web page: …)" or "(Joined online: …)". The enquiry card hides that note, the message does not.
expected: The message leaves out the system note, or uses only the words the person typed.
who: owners and front desk, and the people they message
how_often: every WhatsApp tap on an enquiry that came from the web page or online join
fix_line: Strip the system prefixes before the interest goes into the message

title: The growth Excel file shows a renewal rate the page hides
what: For a month whose 15 renewal days are not over, the page shows "–" for renewal rate and members lost, but the downloaded file gives a rate (often 100%) and a lost count made from the few plans decided so far.
expected: The file leaves the renewal rate and members lost empty for such a month, like the page.
how_often: every download, for the latest one or two months
fix_line: Write the file from the same shown value as the page

title: Workout code check calls entry-machine check-ins "imported"
what: In the summary line of "Check workout code", every matched day that was not at the desk or in the app is counted as "imported". A check-in at the entry machine falls in that group, while the row below it says "Checked in at the entry machine".
expected: The summary names entry-machine check-ins as such, and "imported" only for imported ones.
who: owners and front desk at gyms with an entry machine
how_often: every code check for a member who enters by the machine
fix_line: Count machine check-ins on their own in the summary
